summary: This one-week F2P progress guide demonstrates how to maximize account progression on a new Season 1 account without spending. The most crucial strategy is disciplined summoning: save Heliolite Dice until you have 270 to 300 pulls to guarantee the chosen hero from premium banners, rather than pulling randomly. Progression in early Season 1 is heavily time-gated, so stamina should be spent pre-farming EXP Goblin Lair to immediately jump resonance levels when caps unlock. Gear dungeon farming should be minimized until Stage 15 is available for Mythic gear drops. Additionally, players should continuously upgrade their Island buildings and utilize Familiar Fusion to craft Mythic familiars.

teams.note: Triple support shell (Garius tank, Child of Chaos buffer/healer, Gillian healer) keeping two Frost damage dealers (Auster DPS, Lossenia CC/sub-DPS) alive through all early progression content.

tips: Never pull on premium or option summon banners until you have accumulated 270 to 300 summons to guarantee the featured pity unit.
Do not farm gear dungeons heavily before Stage 15 opens, as Mythic equipment only begins dropping at Stage 15.
Rush Hero Resonance Level to 100 as the top early account priority before investing heavily into gear farming.
Pre-farm EXP in Goblin Lair while time-gated so you can immediately level your resonance roster the moment daily time-gate caps unlock.
Consistently upgrade your Island buildings (Ancestral Idol, Mine, Hatchery, Dispatch Center, and War Room) to boost global stats and dungeon damage reduction.
Use Familiar Fusion on spare familiars: combining Legendary familiars with Epics offers a 5% chance per attempt to craft a Mythic familiar.
